sourceRecords.title: NOK 3.9 billion for two floating offshore wind projects
sourceRecords.sourceText: Enova awarded NOK 2 billion to Fortius Offshore Wind and NOK 1.94 billion to Fram Wind Solutions. Each project plans two 18.5 MW floating turbines at METCentre off Karmoy within five years. The programme supports testing of floating foundations, mooring and construction and operation methods. Payment depends on project implementation.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public source; concise attributed factual paraphrase and provenance retained, not the full article. No broader republication rights assumed.

sourceRecords.title: South Korea Launches Second Offshore Wind Tender in 2026
sourceRecords.sourceText: South Korea announced a second-half fixed-price offshore wind tender opening on 30 October. Of approximately 2,200 MW, about 500 MW is reserved for floating offshore wind and 1,700 MW for fixed-bottom wind. The reported floating-wind bid price ceiling is KRW 174,003/MWh. This is a tender opening, not an award.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public source; concise attributed factual paraphrase and provenance retained, not the full article. No broader republication rights assumed.

sourceRecords.title: Japan and Siemens Energy Form Floating Offshore Wind Pact
sourceRecords.sourceText: METI and Siemens Energy signed a cooperation memorandum addressing floating offshore wind projects in Japan, supply chain development and workforce development. The report also describes a planned Siemens Energy operations and maintenance hub in Hokkaido. No individual wind-farm award is announced.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public source; concise attributed factual paraphrase and provenance retained, not the full article. No broader republication rights assumed.

sourceRecords.title: Tokyo Gas Reportedly Drops 30 MW Fukushima Floating Wind Pilot: Japan Eyes 300 MW for the Next Step
sourceRecords.sourceText: DeepWind cites Nikkei and Fukushima Minyu reporting that Tokyo Gas and Shinobuyama Fukushima Power abandoned their proposed 30 MW floating wind pilot off Naraha and Tomioka amid rising construction costs. The proposed project comprised two 15 MW-class turbines. DeepWind found no company announcement as of 27 October; cancellation and its cause remain attributed press reports.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public source; concise attributed factual paraphrase and provenance retained, not the full article. No broader republication rights assumed.

sourceRecords.title: OCG-Wind and OCG-Data Milestones
sourceRecords.sourceText: Ocergy reports that its OCG-Data buoy was refurbished and redeployed in September for a three-year MARE environmental monitoring campaign at the Golfe de Fos 1 floating wind site. The update also describes the August tow of its 3 MW Culzean platform. These are earlier operations reported this week, not new October installations.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public source; concise attributed factual paraphrase and provenance retained, not the full article. No broader republication rights assumed.

sourceRecords.title: NOC's Autosub Long Range tests new ocean monitoring technologies for floating offshore wind
sourceRecords.sourceText: NOC reports successful Plymouth trials of an upgraded ALR1500 autonomous underwater vehicle for the Frontline floating offshore wind study. Sensors measured physical, biological and chemical conditions, fish, plankton and underwater sound; satellite observations guided missions. The trials inform planned Celtic Sea surveys in 2027. They do not establish environmental impacts of operating wind farms.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public source; concise attributed factual paraphrase and provenance retained, not the full article. No broader republication rights assumed.

briefingItems.title: Enova awards conditional support for four floating turbines
briefingItems.oneLineSummary: Two METCentre demonstration projects receive NOK 3.94 billion in conditional support.
briefingItems.explanation: Enova awarded NOK 2 billion to Fortius Offshore Wind and NOK 1.94 billion to Fram Wind Solutions. Each project plans two 18.5 MW floating turbines at METCentre off Karmoy within five years. The programme supports testing of floating foundations, mooring and construction and operation methods. Payment depends on project implementation.
briefingItems.whyItMatters: The award supports demonstration plans; disbursement depends on implementation.

briefingItems.title: Ocergy reports OCG-Data redeployment for MARE monitoring
briefingItems.oneLineSummary: The company update describes a September monitoring-buoy redeployment and earlier Culzean tow.
briefingItems.explanation: Ocergy reports that its OCG-Data buoy was refurbished and redeployed in September for a three-year MARE environmental monitoring campaign at the Golfe de Fos 1 floating wind site. The update also describes the August tow of its 3 MW Culzean platform. These are earlier operations reported this week, not new October installations.
briefingItems.whyItMatters: The update preserves actual operation dates and attributes commercial-readiness claims to the supplier.

briefingItems.title: Korea opens tender with a 500 MW floating-wind allocation
briefingItems.oneLineSummary: The second-half offshore wind tender separates floating and fixed-bottom allocations.
briefingItems.explanation: South Korea announced a second-half fixed-price offshore wind tender opening on 30 October. Of approximately 2,200 MW, about 500 MW is reserved for floating offshore wind and 1,700 MW for fixed-bottom wind. The reported floating-wind bid price ceiling is KRW 174,003/MWh. This is a tender opening, not an award.
briefingItems.whyItMatters: The announcement opens procurement; it does not identify successful bidders.

briefingItems.title: NOC tests autonomous monitoring suite for floating-wind surveys
briefingItems.oneLineSummary: Plymouth trials combined underwater sensors and satellite-guided mission planning.
briefingItems.explanation: NOC reports successful Plymouth trials of an upgraded ALR1500 autonomous underwater vehicle for the Frontline floating offshore wind study. Sensors measured physical, biological and chemical conditions, fish, plankton and underwater sound; satellite observations guided missions. The trials inform planned Celtic Sea surveys in 2027. They do not establish environmental impacts of operating wind farms.
briefingItems.whyItMatters: This is a monitoring-system trial ahead of wider surveys, not a measured impact conclusion.

briefingItems.title: Japan and Siemens Energy agree floating-wind cooperation
briefingItems.oneLineSummary: The memorandum covers project development, supply chains and workforce training.
briefingItems.explanation: METI and Siemens Energy signed a cooperation memorandum addressing floating offshore wind projects in Japan, supply chain development and workforce development. The report also describes a planned Siemens Energy operations and maintenance hub in Hokkaido. No individual wind-farm award is announced.
briefingItems.whyItMatters: The cooperation framework and planned service hub are distinct from a wind-farm contract.

Ocergy page publication date is 27 October; its dateline is 26 October. August tow and September buoy redeployment are not described as events that occurred this week.
Enova and NOC primary records were obtained through approved trade-source discovery; the registry itself is unchanged.
Additional focused discovery and primary verification queries followed the broad registry pass.
